name: Google BigQuery to Snapchat Audiences
steps:
**1\. Setup a Data Warehouse** - Go to [Data Warehouses](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) Tab and add a BigQuery Warehouse. 

*\*To understand how to add a BigQuery Data Warehouse check out this* [*video*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6061dvlRmaE&t=1s)*.*

**2\. Setup a Data Model** - Navigate to [Data Models](https://console.datachannel.co/data-models) tab and click on [Create New](https://console.datachannel.co/data-models/add). Name your Data Model and select your data warehouse from the drop down. Write a SQL query to fetch data from your warehouse. 

(Eg. *Select* \* *from* ***Schema\_Name***.***Table\_Name***)

*\*A simple “select” statement will work, although you can write complex SQL queries in the data model field itself or use our no-code segment builder to filter your data without writing complex SQL Queries.*

**3\. Configure your Data Destination** - Navigate to [Destinations](https://console.datachannel.co/reverse-connectors) tab and select Snapchat Ads.

-   Add Your Credentials using the “[+](https://api.datachannel.co/datasources/snapchat/credentials/add?token=eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IjVhNTA5ZjAxOWY3MGQ3NzlkODBmMTUyZDFhNWQzMzgxMWFiN2NlZjciLCJ0eXAiOiJKV1QifQ..H3mxolgmADahW6ixialPA98l3Twe7JTNz1HRR-R9ToHag4mE4FvRhzOFGxr5kEG59-4D7i1pjoTK2OWVqvBPEOIidkUQNWWpihc_yW9hzPz_ePqW5pjIqCx_6dq_oGW3z_4Qf3Bd_Yk4R24WJDQGF7b2oKQ7ZCpL3niOZRGJpjhOe5dNlkRLSPNsoDawXPzWgc9rCHWSNwBkmZO3MSxKxaz-s35klwpET_cU8Vw1s6xZKdPZek7u_QquYnxMoQs7wM4zmk1zW2WqZvp5jn2GT4d7Ssg-1w5eah9gX3stxPJwsFTwOQBsJZ62_ADffMCD1uFicuXuiZFwH68T8BJvEQ)” Button. You will easily be able to sign up using OAuth.
